decisions.reason: The resistor-placement decision does not change the standalone USB power source, activation condition, capacity, or powered loads.
The I2C series-resistor topology does not affect the addressable LED supply or data-level shifting requirements.
The source decision concerns I2C signal conditioning, not selection or OR-ing of the main-board power sources.

The candidate's cable length, clock speed, pull-up resistance and board location, and power-board resistor policy remain unchanged; the newly confirmed main-board series-resistor topology is independently owned by the source Requirement.
Connecting resistors directly to the existing ESP32-S3 I2C pins does not reassign any GPIO.
The I2C resistor placement does not alter the battery-charge indicator, connector, GPIO, or resistor configuration.
The source decision does not change the interboard connector architecture, signal pinout, power signals, or matching-numbering policy.
The I2C signal-conditioning topology does not affect the switched 5V boost supply, its enable GPIO, or its powered loads.
The source decision is unrelated to the battery connector's pinout, placement, orientation, or mounting style.
The placement instruction applies to main-board I2C resistors and does not change the power board's dimensions, enclosure fit, mounting holes, or connector arrangement.
The main-board I2C resistor placement has no effect on the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology.
The source decision does not change the LED board's array size or addressable LED requirement.
